title: LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Dallas Admission Ticket
includes: Admission to Legoland Discovery Center Dallas
Admission to Sea Life Aquarium (if option selected)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note: As a children's attraction and to promote a safe and family-friendly environment, adults cannot enter without being accompanied by a child.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience endless family fun at LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Dallas, featuring 15 exciting attractions designed for LEGO lovers of all ages. Build and test your own LEGO creations, explore interactive exhibits, and enjoy a thrilling 4D cinema experience. Perfect for kids and families, LEGOLAND Dallas offers a creative and immersive adventure that sparks imagination and excitement.
